'''Mirru''' was a [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'lek]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] who lived on [[Ord Mantell/Legends|Ord Mantell]] during the [[Separatist War|civil war]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] and the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] between the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]] and the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. Around [[3643 BBY]], he found out about a road ambush, that the [[Mantellian Separatist Movement]] was planning with a couple of bombs. He alerted the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] forces for the eminent treat but was kicked out of their [[Fort Garnik|base]] as they didn't believe him. The Republic however reconsidered his intel and assigned a [[Meteor (Havoc Squad)|promising sergeant]] to retrieve it. Mirru was skeptical at first, but ended accepting to give his intel in exchange for a considerable amount of [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]].
